entries.example: The doctor could not diagnose the cause of her headache.
entries.exampleZh: 医生无法诊断她头痛的原因。

entries.en: a doctor's judgment about an illness
entries.example: The diagnosis came after two days of tests.
entries.exampleZh: 诊断是在两天的检查之后得出的。

entries.en: a simple drawing that explains how something works
entries.example: The manual shows a diagram of the engine's main parts.
entries.exampleZh: 手册里有一张发动机主要部件的示意图。

entries.en: the length of a straight line across a circle
entries.example: The table has a diameter of about one metre.
entries.exampleZh: 这张桌子的直径约为一米。

entries.en: a book where you write about your days
entries.example: She wrote three lines in her diary before bed.
entries.exampleZh: 睡前她在日记里写了三行。

entries.en: a book that lists words and their meanings
entries.example: I looked up the strange word in an online dictionary.
entries.exampleZh: 我在在线词典里查了那个生词。

entries.en: to see or show a difference between things
entries.example: Young children learn to differentiate between coins and buttons.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿学着区分硬币和纽扣。

entries.en: the act of telling things apart or making them different
entries.example: The differentiation of the two samples took only a minute.
entries.exampleZh: 区分这两个样本只用了一分钟。

entries.en: a difficult choice between two options
entries.example: She faced a dilemma between staying home and joining the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 她在留在家里和参加旅行之间左右为难。

entries.en: a compound containing two oxygen atoms
entries.example: The reaction released carbon dioxide into the glass.
entries.exampleZh: 反应把二氧化碳释放到玻璃杯中。

entries.en: a condition that makes something harder or worse
entries.example: The main disadvantage of the plan is its high cost.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划的主要缺点是成本太高。

entries.en: the amount of water pushed aside by an object
entries.example: They measured the displacement of water to find the toy's volume.
entries.exampleZh: 他们测量被排开的水量，以求出玩具的体积。

entries.en: to mix into a liquid and become part of it
entries.example: Sugar will dissolve faster in warm water than in cold.
entries.exampleZh: 糖在温水里比在冷水里溶解得快。

entries.en: an area of knowledge or activity
entries.example: Water research now covers a much wider domain than before.
entries.exampleZh: 水的研究如今涵盖的领域比过去广阔得多。

entries.en: a person or group that gives money or goods
entries.example: An anonymous donor paid for the new school library.
entries.exampleZh: 一位匿名捐赠者出资修建了新校图书馆。

entries.en: the length of time something lasts
entries.example: Visitors may stay for the whole duration of the show.
entries.exampleZh: 观众可以在整个演出期间留在场内。

entries.en: full of change, energy and new activity
entries.example: The market is dynamic, with new products appearing every month.
entries.exampleZh: 这个市场很有活力，每个月都有新产品出现。

entries.en: relating to the relationship between living things and nature
entries.example: The roof garden keeps a delicate ecological balance.
entries.exampleZh: 这个屋顶花园维持着微妙的生态平衡。

entries.en: a tiny particle with a negative charge
entries.example: Each electron in the wire carries a negative charge.
entries.exampleZh: 导线中的每个电子都带负电荷。

entries.en: basic and simple; at the first level
entries.example: The guide explained the idea in elementary terms for children.
entries.exampleZh: 导游用孩子能懂的基础说法解释了这个概念。

entries.en: the male ruler of an empire
entries.example: The emperor ordered a bridge to be built across the river.
entries.exampleZh: 皇帝下令在河上建一座桥。

entries.en: based on tests and observation rather than theory
entries.example: The team needs empirical evidence from real crashes.
entries.exampleZh: 团队需要来自真实车祸的实证证据。

entries.en: a thing that exists separately and has its own identity
entries.example: The law treats the company as a single legal entity.
entries.exampleZh: 法律把这家公司视为一个单一的法律实体。

entries.en: the most important quality or idea of something
entries.example: The essence of her argument is that responsibility cannot be programmed.
entries.exampleZh: 她论点的核心是责任无法被编程。

entries.en: relating to right and wrong behaviour
entries.example: Using such software on real roads raises ethical questions.
entries.exampleZh: 在真实道路上使用这类软件会引发道德问题。

entries.en: rules or beliefs about right and wrong conduct
entries.example: The club follows a strict code of ethics.
entries.exampleZh: 这个社团遵循严格的道德准则。

entries.en: a way out of a building or place
entries.example: We left through the emergency exit at the back.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从后面的紧急出口离开了。

entries.en: special skill or knowledge in a particular field
entries.example: People trusted her expertise because she was a nurse.
entries.exampleZh: 大家信任她的专业能力，因为她是一名护士。

entries.en: a body temperature that is higher than normal
entries.example: Ben had a high fever and stayed home from school.
entries.exampleZh: 本发高烧，留在家里没去上学。

entries.en: a liquid that can flow freely
entries.example: The doctor told him to drink plenty of fluid and rest.
entries.exampleZh: 医生叮嘱他多喝液体并好好休息。

entries.en: a place or meeting where people exchange opinions
entries.example: The town opened an online forum about road safety.
entries.exampleZh: 镇上开设了一个关于道路安全的在线论坛。

entries.en: the remains of an ancient animal or plant in rock
entries.example: He found a fossil of a fish in the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 他在山里发现了一块鱼化石。

entries.en: a small part of a whole amount
entries.example: Only a fraction of the parents came to the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 只有一小部分家长来参加了会议。

entries.en: a crack or break, especially in a bone
entries.example: The fracture in his wrist healed in six weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 他手腕的骨折六周就愈合了。

entries.en: the outer edge of an area or group
entries.example: The new houses stand on the fringe of the old town.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新房子坐落在老城区的边缘。

entries.en: the joining of two or more things into one
entries.example: Her cooking is a fusion of Italian and Japanese styles.
entries.exampleZh: 她的烹饪融合了意大利和日本风格。

entries.en: a device that measures pressure, size or amount
entries.example: The pressure gauge showed that the tank was almost empty.
entries.exampleZh: 压力表显示水箱几乎空了。

entries.en: a farm animal with horns that gives milk
entries.example: The farmer keeps a goat for milk and cheese.
entries.exampleZh: 农夫养了一只山羊来挤奶和做奶酪。

entries.en: a drawing that shows how numbers change
entries.example: The graph shows electricity use rising sharply in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 这张图表显示冬季用电量急剧上升。

entries.en: a pattern of straight lines that cross to form squares
entries.example: The town is built on a grid of straight streets.
entries.exampleZh: 这座小镇建立在笔直街道构成的网格上。

entries.en: a strong feeling you cannot explain
entries.example: She trusted her gut and turned down the offer.
entries.exampleZh: 她相信自己的直觉，拒绝了这个提议。

entries.en: the natural home of a plant or animal
entries.example: The pond is an important habitat for rare frogs.
entries.exampleZh: 这个池塘是稀有蛙类的重要栖息地。

entries.en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered
entries.example: The apple harvest was smaller than last year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年的苹果收成比去年少。

entries.en: a system in which people or things are ranked
entries.example: The company has a strict hierarchy of managers.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司有严格的经理层级。

entries.en: the line where the sky seems to meet the land
entries.example: The sun sank slowly below the horizon.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳慢慢沉到地平线以下。

entries.en: flat and going from side to side
entries.example: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page.
entries.exampleZh: 在页面中间画一条水平线。

entries.en: a chemical in the body that controls growth or mood
entries.example: Stress can raise the level of this hormone in the blood.
entries.exampleZh: 压力会提高血液中这种激素的水平。

entries.en: a light gas that burns easily and has no colour
entries.example: The bus runs on hydrogen instead of diesel.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆公交车用氢气而不是柴油行驶。

entries.en: a false idea, or something that seems real but is not
entries.example: The mirror creates the illusion of a larger room.
entries.exampleZh: 这面镜子营造出房间更大的错觉。

entries.en: suggested but not said directly
entries.example: Her silence gave implicit approval to the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她的沉默等于隐含地批准了这个计划。

entries.en: a sudden wish to do something without thinking
entries.example: He bought the expensive watch on impulse.
entries.exampleZh: 他一时冲动买下了那块昂贵的手表。

entries.en: how often something happens
entries.example: The incidence of flu rises every winter.
entries.exampleZh: 流感的发病率每年冬天都会上升。

entries.en: a slope, or a surface that slopes
entries.example: The road climbs a steep incline to the church.
entries.exampleZh: 这条路沿着陡坡通向教堂。

entries.en: the act of including people or things
entries.example: The school is proud of its inclusion of disabled students.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校为接纳残疾学生而自豪。

entries.en: lack of interest or concern
entries.example: He listened to the warning with complete indifference.
entries.exampleZh: 他完全漠不关心地听着那个警告。

entries.en: native to a place rather than brought there
entries.example: These indigenous plants need very little water.
entries.exampleZh: 这些本土植物需要的水很少。

entries.en: not straight or direct
entries.example: The lamp gives a soft, indirect light.
entries.exampleZh: 这盏灯发出柔和的间接光。

entries.en: to cause something to happen
entries.example: Warm weather can induce early flowering.
entries.exampleZh: 温暖的天气会促使植物提前开花。

entries.en: a conclusion drawn from evidence
entries.example: From the data we can draw a clear inference.
entries.exampleZh: 从这些数据中我们可以得出明确的推论。

entries.en: having no limit or end
entries.example: Learning a language requires infinite patience.
entries.exampleZh: 学习一门语言需要无限的耐心。

entries.en: relaxed and not following official rules
entries.example: We had an informal chat over coffee.
entries.exampleZh: 我们边喝咖啡边随意聊了聊。

entries.en: to slow down or prevent something
entries.example: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these plants.
entries.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会抑制这些植物的生长。

entries.en: a feeling that makes you shy or unable to act freely
entries.example: After a few songs, her inhibition faded and she began to dance with us.
entries.exampleZh: 几首歌过后，她的拘谨消失了，开始和我们一起跳舞。

entries.en: a small creature with six legs and a body in three parts
entries.example: A tiny insect landed on the rim of my glass and stayed there.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小昆虫落在我杯子的边缘，停在那里不走。

entries.en: necessary and essential to the whole
entries.example: Regular practice is an integral part of learning a musical instrument.
entries.exampleZh: 经常练习是学习乐器不可或缺的一部分。

entries.en: the screen and controls through which a user works with a device
entries.example: The new interface makes it much easier to find the settings you need.
entries.exampleZh: 新的界面让你更容易找到需要的设置。

entries.en: a period of time between two events
entries.example: Buses run at an interval of twenty minutes on weekdays.
entries.exampleZh: 工作日公交车每隔二十分钟一班。

entries.en: to enter a place in large numbers and cause harm
entries.example: Ants invade our kitchen every summer through a crack in the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 每年夏天，蚂蚁都从墙缝里侵入我们的厨房。

entries.en: a lively style of music with a strong rhythm and improvisation
entries.example: The band played soft jazz while we ate dinner on the terrace.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在露台吃晚饭时，乐队演奏了轻柔的爵士乐。

entries.en: a flat green part growing from a plant or tree
entries.example: A yellow leaf drifted down onto the quiet pond.
entries.exampleZh: 一片黄叶飘落到平静的池塘上。

entries.en: time when you are free from work and can relax
entries.example: He spends his leisure reading detective novels on the balcony.
entries.exampleZh: 他闲暇时在阳台上读侦探小说。

entries.en: a bar used to lift or move something heavy
entries.example: He used a metal bar as a lever to open the heavy lid.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一根金属棒作杠杆，撬开了沉重的盖子。

entries.en: in the same way; also
entries.example: She spoke politely to the guests, and her children behaved likewise.
entries.exampleZh: 她对客人说话很有礼貌，她的孩子们也同样有礼。

entries.en: an arm or a leg of a person or animal
entries.example: The climber hurt a limb when he fell from the rock.
entries.exampleZh: 那名攀登者从岩石上摔下来时伤到了一条胳膊。

entries.en: arranged in a straight line or increasing evenly
entries.example: The graph shows a steady, linear rise in temperature over the month.
entries.exampleZh: 这张图显示整个月气温呈平稳的线性上升。

entries.en: relating to language or the study of language
entries.example: The two regions differ in both geography and linguistic tradition.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个地区在地理和语言传统上都不相同。

entries.en: the scientific study of language and its structure
entries.example: She studied linguistics and now designs tools for language learners.
entries.exampleZh: 她学过语言学，现在为语言学习者设计工具。

entries.en: a large organ that cleans the blood
entries.example: The doctor said his liver had recovered after months without alcohol.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说，他戒酒几个月后肝脏已经恢复。

entries.en: a shape or process that returns to its starting point
entries.example: The program fell into an endless loop and stopped responding.
entries.exampleZh: 程序陷入了无休止的循环，不再响应。

entries.en: one of the two organs used for breathing
entries.example: A deep breath filled his left lung with cold mountain air.
entries.exampleZh: 他深吸一口气，冰冷的山间空气充满左肺。

entries.en: the great size or importance of something
entries.example: Few people grasped the magnitude of the earthquake until the reports arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 在报道传来之前，很少有人意识到这场地震的严重程度。

entries.en: a document written by hand or typed before printing
entries.example: The author sent her manuscript to three publishers before one accepted it.
entries.exampleZh: 这位作者把手稿寄给了三家出版社，才有一家接受。

entries.en: a hard stone with patterns, often polished for building
entries.example: The old bank had a marble floor that shone under the lamps.
entries.exampleZh: 那家老银行的大理石地面在灯光下闪闪发亮。

entries.en: a grid of rows and columns holding data or values
entries.example: The students entered the numbers into a matrix on the screen.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们把数字输入屏幕上的矩阵。

entries.en: to make something as large or effective as possible
entries.example: The farmers changed their planting dates to maximize the harvest.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们调整了播种日期，以使收成最大化。

entries.en: to help two sides reach an agreement
entries.example: A senior teacher was asked to mediate between the two students.
entries.exampleZh: 一位资深教师被请来在两名学生之间调解。

entries.en: a way of describing something by comparing it to another thing
entries.example: Her poem uses the sea as a metaphor for memory.
entries.exampleZh: 她的诗用大海来比喻记忆。

entries.en: a natural solid substance found in rock or the ground
entries.example: This water contains several minerals that are good for the body.
entries.exampleZh: 这种水含有几种对身体有益的矿物质。

entries.en: as small or simple as possible
entries.example: The room was plain, with minimal furniture and white walls.
entries.exampleZh: 房间很朴素，家具极少，墙壁雪白。

entries.en: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount
entries.example: They left early to minimize the risk of missing the train.
entries.exampleZh: 他们早早出发，以尽量降低错过火车的风险。

entries.en: the force that keeps something moving or developing
entries.example: The campaign gained momentum after the local newspaper published the story.
entries.exampleZh: 当地报纸刊登报道后，这场运动的势头增强了。

entries.en: connected with money
entries.example: The project depended on monetary support from small local donors.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目依靠当地小额捐助者的资金支持。

entries.en: complete control of a market by one company
entries.example: The chain hoped to establish a monopoly over bookselling in the town.
entries.exampleZh: 这家连锁店希望垄断镇上的图书销售。

entries.en: to increase greatly in number
entries.example: Volunteers watched the number of supporters multiply week after week.
entries.exampleZh: 志愿者们看着支持者的数量一周接一周地成倍增加。

entries.en: something you need rather than merely want
entries.example: For the owner, a quiet reading room was a necessity, not a luxury.
entries.exampleZh: 对店主来说，一间安静的阅览室是必需品，而不是奢侈品。

entries.en: morally good and deserving respect
entries.example: Saving a much-loved bookshop felt like a noble cause to everyone involved.
entries.exampleZh: 对每个参与者来说，挽救一家深受喜爱的书店似乎是件高尚的事。

entries.en: despite what has just been said
entries.example: The rent was high; nonetheless, the shop stayed open.
entries.exampleZh: 租金很高；尽管如此，书店还是继续营业。

entries.en: not changing in a straight, proportional way
entries.example: Visitor numbers followed a nonlinear pattern, jumping in spring and falling in autumn.
entries.exampleZh: 访客数量呈现非线性模式，春季骤增，秋季下降。

entries.en: a standard or usual way of behaving
entries.example: Working from home has become the norm in many offices.
entries.exampleZh: 在家办公在许多办公室已成为常态。

entries.en: hard to understand or not well known
entries.example: The professor's explanation was too obscure for most of the audience.
entries.exampleZh: 教授的解释对大多数听众来说太晦涩了。

entries.en: relating to light or the sense of sight
entries.example: The museum uses optical illusions to explain how our eyes work.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆用视觉错觉来解释我们的眼睛如何工作。

entries.en: a living thing, especially a very small one
entries.example: The pond is full of tiny organisms that feed on algae.
entries.exampleZh: 池塘里满是以藻类为食的微小生物。

entries.en: a way through which something is expressed or released
entries.example: Painting gave the boy a healthy outlet for his anger.
entries.exampleZh: 画画给了这个男孩一个健康的发泄怒气的途径。

entries.en: relating to the regular costs of running a business
entries.example: The café closed because its overhead costs were too high.
entries.exampleZh: 这家咖啡馆因日常开支太高而关门。

entries.en: a shared part or amount in common
entries.example: There is considerable overlap between the two research projects.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个研究项目之间有相当大的重叠。

entries.en: the gas in air that living things need to breathe
entries.example: The patient was given extra oxygen after the operation.
entries.exampleZh: 病人术后得到了额外的氧气。

entries.en: a situation that seems contradictory but may be true
entries.example: It is a paradox that the newest windows let in the most pollution.
entries.exampleZh: 最新的窗户反而放进最多的污染物，这是个悖论。

entries.en: a limit or factor that controls how something works
entries.example: The engineers changed one parameter at a time during the test.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在测试中一次只改变一个参数。

entries.en: a very small piece of something
entries.example: Fine particles from traffic can enter the lungs.
entries.exampleZh: 交通产生的细小微粒会进入肺部。

entries.en: not central or important
entries.example: The report focused on air quality and treated paint colour as a peripheral issue.
entries.exampleZh: 报告聚焦空气质量，把油漆颜色当作次要问题。

entries.en: a doctor who treats illnesses
entries.example: The physician asked the engineers to measure the air in the school.
entries.exampleZh: 这位医生请工程师测量学校里的空气。

entries.en: the science of matter, energy and forces
entries.example: She borrowed ideas from physics to draw the falling petal.
entries.exampleZh: 她借用物理学的概念来画那片飘落的花瓣。

entries.en: in the form that refers to more than one
entries.example: The word 'projects' should be plural in the title.
entries.exampleZh: 标题里的“projects”一词应该用复数。

entries.en: relating to the North or South Pole
entries.example: Her series of paintings shows penguins in the polar regions.
entries.exampleZh: 她的系列画作描绘了极地地区的企鹅。

entries.en: a collection of someone's work or investments
entries.example: She spread her whole portfolio across the kitchen table.
entries.exampleZh: 她把整本作品集摊在厨房桌上。

entries.en: to show or describe someone in a picture or story
entries.example: The painting tries to portray her grandfather as a young sailor.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画试图把她祖父描绘成一名年轻水手。

entries.en: the way someone or something is shown or described
entries.example: His portrayal of the old sailor is affectionate rather than accurate.
entries.exampleZh: 他对那位老水手的描绘充满感情，而不追求准确。

entries.en: a large printed picture or notice put on a wall
entries.example: One poster showed a family of penguins under a black sky.
entries.exampleZh: 一张海报上画着漆黑天空下的一家企鹅。

entries.en: an animal that hunts and eats others
entries.example: The lion is a powerful predator that hunts at night.
entries.exampleZh: 狮子是夜间捕猎的强壮掠食动物。

entries.en: mostly; mainly
entries.example: The crowd was predominantly made up of students and young workers.
entries.exampleZh: 人群主要由学生和年轻工人组成。

entries.en: an unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge
entries.example: She grew up with a prejudice against people from big cities.
entries.exampleZh: 她从小对大城市来的人抱有偏见。

entries.en: coming before the main part
entries.example: The preliminary results suggest the new method works well.
entries.exampleZh: 初步结果表明这种新方法效果良好。

entries.en: the fact of being common or widespread
entries.example: The prevalence of cheap phones has changed how teenagers talk.
entries.exampleZh: 廉价手机的普及改变了青少年的交流方式。

entries.en: an animal hunted and eaten by another
entries.example: Rabbits are easy prey for foxes and large birds.
entries.exampleZh: 兔子容易成为狐狸和大鸟的猎物。

entries.en: belonging to a very early stage; simple
entries.example: The museum shows primitive tools made of stone and bone.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出用石头和骨头制成的原始工具。

entries.en: a suggestion or idea offered for consideration
entries.example: Her proposition to share the rent sounded fair to everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 她分摊房租的提议在大家听来很公平。

entries.en: an official set of rules or steps to follow
entries.example: The lab protocol requires gloves and a careful check of every sample.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室规程要求戴手套并仔细检查每个样本。

entries.en: the regular beat of blood in the body
entries.example: The nurse checked his pulse after the long run.
entries.exampleZh: 长跑之后护士检查了他的脉搏。

entries.en: a set of written questions used to collect information
entries.example: Please fill in the questionnaire before you leave the clinic.
entries.exampleZh: 离开诊所前请填好这份问卷。

entries.en: a frame used for holding or storing things
entries.example: He put the clean glasses back on the rack.
entries.exampleZh: 他把干净的杯子放回架子上。

entries.en: a particular area of activity or knowledge
entries.example: Space travel once belonged to the realm of science fiction.
entries.exampleZh: 太空旅行曾属于科幻小说的领域。

entries.en: a return to an earlier state, or a statistical method
entries.example: The team used regression to test how sleep affects test scores.
entries.exampleZh: 团队用回归分析检验睡眠如何影响考试成绩。

entries.en: the process of recovering health or normal life
entries.example: After the accident, he spent months in rehabilitation learning to walk.
entries.exampleZh: 事故之后，他花了几个月做康复训练，重新学习走路。

entries.en: remaining after the main part has gone
entries.example: She still felt some residual tiredness two days after the race.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛两天后她仍感到一些残留的疲惫。

entries.en: a small amount left after a process
entries.example: Wipe the pan to remove the oily residue.
entries.exampleZh: 擦一下锅，去掉油腻的残渣。

entries.en: to get something back from a place
entries.example: The dog ran into the water to retrieve the stick.
entries.exampleZh: 狗跑进水里把木棍取回来。

entries.en: language used to persuade, often without much meaning
entries.example: His speech was full of rhetoric but offered no clear plan.
entries.exampleZh: 他的演讲满是漂亮说辞，却没有提出明确的计划。

entries.en: a machine that can do tasks automatically
entries.example: A small robot now delivers medicine inside the hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 现在一台小机器人在医院里送药。

entries.en: to turn around a central point
entries.example: Turn the handle and the wheels rotate slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 转动把手，轮子就会慢慢旋转。

entries.en: the act of turning around a center
entries.example: The rotation of the earth gives us day and night.
entries.exampleZh: 地球的自转给我们带来昼夜。

entries.en: a described situation that might happen
entries.example: In the worst scenario, the bus would not arrive until midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 在最坏的设想中，公交车要到午夜才来。

entries.en: money given to a student to pay for study
entries.example: She won a scholarship that covers her tuition and books.
entries.exampleZh: 她获得了一份涵盖学费和书本费的奖学金。

entries.en: a small class or meeting for discussion
entries.example: Our seminar on urban gardens meets every Thursday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们关于城市花园的研讨课每周四下午上课。

entries.en: great excitement or a physical feeling
entries.example: Her first novel became a sensation among young readers.
entries.exampleZh: 她的第一部小说在年轻读者中引起了轰动。

entries.en: not deep
entries.example: The children played in the shallow end of the pool.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在泳池的浅水区玩耍。

entries.en: to copy the way something works
entries.example: The software can simulate how traffic moves through the city.
entries.exampleZh: 这个软件能模拟交通在城市中的流动。

entries.en: a computer model that copies a real situation
entries.example: Engineers ran a simulation to see how the crowd would move through the station.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们运行了一次模拟，查看人群会如何穿过车站。

entries.en: a quick, rough drawing
entries.example: She made a quick sketch of the garden before buying any plants.
entries.exampleZh: 买植物之前，她先给花园画了一张速写。

entries.en: to not do something you usually do
entries.example: I sometimes skip breakfast when I am late for class.
entries.exampleZh: 上课要迟到的时候，我有时会不吃早饭。

entries.en: a place where something can fit, or a period in a schedule
entries.example: The table fits neatly into the narrow slot beside the door.
entries.exampleZh: 这张桌子正好放进门边那个窄窄的空位。

entries.en: a soft silver-white metal found in salt
entries.example: Too much sodium in packaged food can raise your blood pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 包装食品中钠含量过高会使血压升高。

entries.en: a period of time between two points
entries.example: Her interest in birds grew over a span of ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 她对鸟类的兴趣在十年间逐渐增长。

entries.en: relating to space and position
entries.example: The test measures how well children understand spatial relationships.
entries.exampleZh: 这项测试衡量儿童对空间关系的理解程度。

entries.en: a small sample used for study or testing
entries.example: The biologist kept each specimen in a small labelled jar.
entries.exampleZh: 生物学家把每个标本都保存在贴好标签的小罐子里。

entries.en: the colours of light, or a full range of things
entries.example: The survey covered a wide spectrum of ages and incomes.
entries.exampleZh: 这项调查涵盖了不同年龄和收入的人群。

entries.en: a round object, or an area of activity
entries.example: The lamp was shaped like a glass sphere above the table.
entries.exampleZh: 桌子上方的灯呈玻璃球体的形状。

entries.en: done suddenly without planning
entries.example: Her spontaneous laughter made everyone in the room relax.
entries.exampleZh: 她发自内心的笑声让房间里的每个人都放松下来。

entries.en: a pile of things placed on top of each other
entries.example: A stack of old magazines covered the corner of his desk.
entries.exampleZh: 一叠旧杂志占满了他书桌的一角。

entries.en: a large sports ground with seats around it
entries.example: The new stadium can hold sixty thousand fans.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新体育场能容纳六万名球迷。

entries.en: an opinion you publicly express about something
entries.example: The mayor's stance on the new road surprised local shop owners.
entries.exampleZh: 市长对新修道路的立场让当地店主感到意外。

entries.en: a fixed, too simple idea about a group
entries.example: The film challenges the stereotype that engineers cannot communicate.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影挑战了工程师不善沟通的刻板印象。

entries.en: something that causes a reaction or encourages action
entries.example: The grant acted as a stimulus for new research in the department.
entries.exampleZh: 这笔拨款推动了该系的新研究。

entries.en: clear and easy to understand
entries.example: Her instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
entries.exampleZh: 她的指示直截了当，容易照做。

entries.en: a single thin piece of thread or hair
entries.example: A single strand of silk caught the light as it fell.
entries.exampleZh: 一缕丝线飘落时在光下闪了一下。

entries.en: a long narrow band of colour
entries.example: The cat has dark stripes along its back and tail.
entries.exampleZh: 这只猫的背部和尾巴上有深色条纹。

entries.en: based on personal feelings rather than facts
entries.example: Taste in music is subjective, so no answer is simply right.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐品味是主观的，所以没有哪个答案绝对正确。

entries.en: a doctor who performs operations
entries.example: The surgeon explained the operation to the family before surgery.
entries.exampleZh: 手术前，外科医生向家属解释了这台手术。

entries.en: an amount left over after needs are met
entries.example: The farm sold its surplus of apples at the weekend market.
entries.exampleZh: 农场在周末集市上卖掉了多余的苹果。

entries.en: a set of symptoms that often appear together
entries.example: The doctor recognised the syndrome from a set of common symptoms.
entries.exampleZh: 医生根据一组常见症状认出了这种综合征。

entries.en: a combination of different ideas or things
entries.example: Her book is a synthesis of history, science and personal memory.
entries.exampleZh: 她的书是历史、科学和个人记忆的综合。

entries.en: a building where journeys by bus or plane begin and end
entries.example: We waited at the bus terminal until the last coach arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在公交总站一直等到最后一班长途车到站。

entries.en: a long piece of writing based on research
entries.example: He spent two years collecting data for his master's thesis.
entries.exampleZh: 他花了两年时间为硕士论文收集数据。

entries.en: a line of connection between ideas or events
entries.example: A single thread of evidence connected the two cases.
entries.exampleZh: 一条证据线索把这两起案件联系了起来。

entries.en: the level at which something starts to happen
entries.example: The noise rose above the threshold that the law allows at night.
entries.exampleZh: 噪音超过了法律允许的夜间限值。

entries.en: the short thick finger on the side of your hand
entries.example: She hurt her thumb while opening the heavy jar.
entries.exampleZh: 她打开那个沉重的罐子时弄伤了拇指。

entries.en: containing poison and harmful to living things
entries.example: The factory released toxic waste into the river last year.
entries.exampleZh: 那家工厂去年把有毒废料排进了河里。

entries.en: a particular quality of a person or thing
entries.example: Patience is a trait that good teachers often share.
entries.exampleZh: 耐心是好老师常常共有的一种特质。

entries.en: the act of writing down spoken words or copying text
entries.example: The transcription of the interview took almost two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 把那次采访转写成文字花了将近两个小时。

entries.en: an operation that moves an organ to another body
entries.example: His sister donated a kidney for the transplant.
entries.exampleZh: 他的姐姐为这次移植捐出了一颗肾。

entries.en: deep shock or injury after a very upsetting event
entries.example: She still felt the trauma of the accident years later.
entries.exampleZh: 多年以后，她仍能感到那场事故留下的创伤。

entries.en: a shape with three straight sides and three angles
entries.example: The child drew a triangle around the number three.
entries.exampleZh: 那个孩子在数字三周围画了一个三角形。

entries.en: from or typical of the hot regions near the equator
entries.example: Tropical rain fell every afternoon during our holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 假期里每天下午都下热带阵雨。

entries.en: an unusual growth of cells in the body
entries.example: The scan showed a small tumor on his lung.
entries.exampleZh: 扫描显示他的肺上有一个小肿瘤。

entries.en: a teacher who helps one student or a small group
entries.example: My tutor explained the difficult chapter again after class.
entries.exampleZh: 课后我的辅导老师又讲了一遍那个难懂的章节。

entries.en: to make something weaker or less secure
entries.example: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 不断的批评会削弱孩子的信心。

entries.en: to join people or parts into one whole
entries.example: The coach tried to unify the team before the final.
entries.exampleZh: 教练在决赛前努力让全队团结起来。

entries.en: toward a higher place or level
entries.example: Prices have moved steadily upward since the spring.
entries.exampleZh: 从春天起物价一直稳步上涨。

entries.en: to use something in an effective way
entries.example: We should utilize the spare room as a study.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应该把空房间用作书房。

entries.en: something that a person says aloud
entries.example: Every utterance in the meeting was recorded by the secretary.
entries.exampleZh: 会上说出的每一句话都被秘书记录了下来。

entries.en: a tube that carries blood back to the heart
entries.example: The nurse found a vein on the back of his hand.
entries.exampleZh: 护士在他手背上找到了一根静脉。

entries.en: spoken rather than written; relating to words
entries.example: She gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
entries.exampleZh: 她做了口头警告，而不是书面警告。

entries.en: going straight up and down
entries.example: The climber kept her body vertical against the rock.
entries.exampleZh: 攀登者让身体紧贴岩壁保持垂直。

entries.en: able to work successfully; possible to do
entries.example: Solar power is a viable choice for this village.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳能对这个村子来说是一个可行的选择。

entries.en: a substance in food that the body needs to stay healthy
entries.example: Oranges are rich in vitamin C and easy to carry.
entries.exampleZh: 橙子富含维生素C，而且便于携带。

entries.en: relating to the stomach area of the body
entries.example: He felt a sharp abdominal pain after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭后他感到腹部一阵剧痛。

entries.en: a total formed by adding several amounts together
entries.example: The aggregate of the three scores decided the winner.
entries.exampleZh: 三项得分加起来的总数决定了胜者。

entries.en: a set of steps a computer follows to solve a problem
entries.example: The new algorithm sorts the photos by date.
entries.exampleZh: 新的算法会按日期给照片排序。

entries.en: the height of a place above sea level
entries.example: At this altitude the air is thin and cold.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个海拔上，空气稀薄而寒冷。

entries.en: a comparison that explains one thing by another
entries.example: He used an analogy to make the theory clear.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一个类比把这个理论讲清楚了。

entries.en: a medicine that kills or stops bacteria
entries.example: The doctor gave her an antibiotic for the infection.
entries.exampleZh: 医生给她开了抗生素来治感染。

entries.en: a protein the body makes to fight a disease
entries.example: Her body produced an antibody that fought the virus.
entries.exampleZh: 她的身体产生了一种对抗病毒的抗体。

entries.en: a section at the end of a book with extra information
entries.example: The full data table appears in the appendix of the report.
entries.exampleZh: 完整的数据表出现在报告的附录里。

entries.en: clapping by an audience to show approval
entries.example: The audience burst into applause when the young pianist finished.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻的钢琴家演奏结束时，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。

entries.en: based on personal choice rather than a clear rule
entries.example: The teacher made an arbitrary decision about which essays to grade first.
entries.exampleZh: 老师随意决定了先批改哪些作文。

entries.en: the imaginary line around which something turns
entries.example: The Earth rotates on its axis once every twenty-four hours.
entries.exampleZh: 地球每二十四小时绕地轴自转一周。

entries.en: a metal or plastic support fixed to a wall or pole
entries.example: He fixed a metal bracket to the wall and put the shelf on it.
entries.exampleZh: 他把一个金属支架固定在墙上，然后把架子放了上去。

entries.en: a number that shows how strongly one quantity affects another
entries.example: The engineer calculated the coefficient that links wind speed to power output.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师计算了把风速与功率输出联系起来的系数。

entries.en: made by combining two or more different materials
entries.example: The bike frame is made of a light composite material.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆自行车的车架由一种轻质复合材料制成。

entries.en: a shape with a round base that narrows to a point
entries.example: The children built a tall cone out of coloured paper.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们用彩纸做了一个高高的圆锥体。

entries.en: to come together from different directions to one point
entries.example: Two rivers converge just outside the old town.
entries.exampleZh: 两条河在老城外不远处汇合。

entries.en: the process of coming together or becoming similar
entries.example: The convergence of the two currents created a dangerous whirlpool.
entries.exampleZh: 两股水流的汇合形成了一个危险的漩涡。

entries.en: a signal that tells someone to begin or do something
entries.example: The whistle was our cue to start the race.
entries.exampleZh: 哨声就是我们开始比赛的信号。

entries.en: a solid shape with straight sides and circular ends
entries.example: He poured the water into a tall glass cylinder.
entries.exampleZh: 他把水倒进一个高高的玻璃圆筒里。

entries.en: to make something worse in quality or condition
entries.example: Heavy traffic can degrade the air quality in city centres.
entries.exampleZh: 繁忙的交通会使市中心的空气质量下降。

entries.en: the land at a river mouth where it splits into branches
entries.example: Farmers grow rice on the fertile delta of the great river.
entries.exampleZh: 农民在这条大河的肥沃三角洲上种植水稻。

entries.en: a difference from what is usual or expected
entries.example: The scientist noticed a small deviation from the expected result.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家注意到结果与预期有一处小小的偏差。

entries.en: used to find out what is wrong or what is present
entries.example: The doctor ran a diagnostic test to find the cause of the fever.
entries.exampleZh: 医生做了一项诊断性检查，以找出发烧的原因。

entries.en: a difference in amount or level between two things
entries.example: There is a large differential between the two workers' pay.
entries.exampleZh: 这两名工人的工资之间存在很大的差距。

entries.en: the movement of particles from one area to another
entries.example: The diffusion of the scent through the room took only a minute.
entries.exampleZh: 气味在房间里扩散只用了一分钟。

entries.en: to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid
entries.example: You should dilute the juice with water before giving it to a baby.
entries.exampleZh: 给婴儿喝之前，你应该用水把果汁稀释一下。

entries.en: the state of being more powerful or common than others
entries.example: The dominance of one team made the match rather boring.
entries.exampleZh: 一支球队的绝对优势让这场比赛相当乏味。

entries.en: to give something a colour with a special substance
entries.example: She used berries to dye the cloth a deep red.
entries.exampleZh: 她用浆果把布染成深红色。

entries.en: the study of how living things relate to their environment
entries.example: The course covers the ecology of rivers and wetlands.
entries.exampleZh: 这门课程涉及河流与湿地的生态学。

entries.en: able to stretch and return to its original shape
entries.example: The waistband is elastic, so the trousers fit most people.
entries.exampleZh: 腰带是有弹性的，所以这条裤子适合大多数人。

entries.en: the ability of a material to stretch and spring back
entries.example: Rubber has great elasticity and can be stretched many times.
entries.exampleZh: 橡胶弹性很好，可以被反复拉伸。

entries.en: to fix something firmly and deeply inside another thing
entries.example: The engineers embed a small chip in each new phone.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在每部新手机里嵌入一枚小芯片。

entries.en: a natural substance that speeds up chemical changes in living things
entries.example: This enzyme helps the body break down starch quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 这种酶帮助身体迅速分解淀粉。

entries.en: a disease that spreads quickly among many people
entries.example: The flu epidemic forced many schools to close for a week.
entries.exampleZh: 流感疫情迫使许多学校停课一周。

entries.en: a stable state in which opposing forces are equal
entries.example: The tightrope walker kept her equilibrium with a long pole.
entries.exampleZh: 走钢丝的人用一根长杆保持平衡。

entries.en: to remove marks or information completely
entries.example: Please erase the notes on the board before the next class.
entries.exampleZh: 请在下节课前把黑板上的笔记擦掉。

entries.en: a feeling of being extremely tired
entries.example: After the long hike, fatigue made every step feel heavy.
entries.exampleZh: 长途徒步之后，疲劳让每一步都变得沉重。

entries.en: a living thing that grows like a plant but has no leaves
entries.example: A white fungus was growing on the damp wall of the cellar.
entries.exampleZh: 地窖潮湿的墙上长着一层白色的真菌。

entries.en: a unit for measuring weight, one thousandth of a kilogram
entries.example: Add just one gram of salt to the soup.
entries.exampleZh: 汤里只加一克盐。

entries.en: a large bird that hunts small animals
entries.example: A hawk hovered above the field, looking for mice.
entries.exampleZh: 一只鹰在田野上方盘旋，寻找老鼠。

entries.en: currently holding an official position
entries.example: The incumbent mayor promised to repair the old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 现任市长承诺修好那座旧桥。

entries.en: worse in quality than something else
entries.example: The cheaper paint was clearly inferior to the brand we used before.
entries.exampleZh: 那种便宜的油漆明显不如我们以前用的牌子。

entries.en: at a level between beginner and advanced
entries.example: She joined an intermediate class after two years of practice.
entries.exampleZh: 练了两年之后，她加入了一个中级班。

entries.en: an atom with an electric charge
entries.example: Salt breaks into ions when it dissolves in water.
entries.exampleZh: 盐溶于水时会分解成离子。

entries.en: an organ that removes waste from the blood
entries.example: His kidney stopped working, so he needs dialysis.
entries.exampleZh: 他的肾脏停止工作了，所以他需要透析。

entries.en: relating to the side
entries.example: The lateral door leads to a small garden.
entries.exampleZh: 侧面那扇门通向一个小花园。

entries.en: a large building with many shops
entries.example: We spent the afternoon at the new mall downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在市中心的新购物中心待了一下午。

entries.en: related to a mother or her side of the family
entries.example: Her maternal grandmother taught her to make bread.
entries.exampleZh: 她的外祖母教她做面包。

entries.en: a thin layer that covers or separates something
entries.example: The cell is protected by a thin outer membrane.
entries.exampleZh: 细胞由一层薄薄的外膜保护着。

entries.en: a person who carries a message or package
entries.example: A messenger delivered the letter to our door.
entries.exampleZh: 一名信使把信送到了我们门口。

entries.en: a design or image that repeats
entries.example: The curtains are decorated with a flower motif.
entries.exampleZh: 窗帘上装饰着花朵图案。

entries.en: operating in many countries
entries.example: She works for a multinational company based in Europe.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一家总部位于欧洲的跨国公司工作。

entries.en: a change in the genes of a living thing
entries.example: A rare mutation gave the plant white flowers.
entries.exampleZh: 一次罕见的突变让这株植物开出了白花。

entries.en: a position or role that suits someone or something
entries.example: The small bookshop found a niche among online sellers.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小书店在网络卖家之间找到了自己的位置。

entries.en: a gas that makes up most of the air
entries.example: Plants need nitrogen to grow strong green leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 植物需要氮才能长出健壮的绿叶。

entries.en: a point where parts join
entries.example: A new leaf grew from a node on the stem.
entries.exampleZh: 一片新叶从茎上的节处长了出来。

entries.en: existing in name only; very small
entries.example: He is the nominal head, but she makes the decisions.
entries.exampleZh: 他是名义上的负责人，但做决定的是她。

entries.en: the central part of a cell that holds DNA
entries.example: The nucleus of the cell contains the genetic material.
entries.exampleZh: 细胞核里含有遗传物质。

entries.en: shown in or using numbers
entries.example: The report presents the results in numerical form.
entries.exampleZh: 报告以数字形式呈现了结果。

entries.en: a substance that living things need to grow
entries.example: Fresh vegetables are an important source of nutrients.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜蔬菜是重要的营养来源。

entries.en: the children or young of a person or animal
entries.example: The birds feed their offspring for several weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 这些鸟要喂养后代好几周。

entries.en: the beginning of something, especially something bad
entries.example: Doctors hope to delay the onset of the disease.
entries.exampleZh: 医生希望能推迟这种疾病的发作。

entries.en: best possible for a situation
entries.example: Morning is the optimal time for a long run.
entries.exampleZh: 早晨是长跑的最佳时间。

entries.en: to find your position or adjust to something
entries.example: New students need time to orient themselves on campus.
entries.exampleZh: 新生需要时间熟悉校园环境。

entries.en: a short general description of something
entries.example: The first chapter gives a brief overview of the whole subject.
entries.exampleZh: 第一章简要概述了整个学科。

entries.en: the usual or expected level of something
entries.example: His second round was three strokes under par.
entries.exampleZh: 他的第二轮成绩低于标准杆三杆。

entries.en: a typical model or way of thinking
entries.example: The discovery changed the paradigm of modern physics.
entries.exampleZh: 这一发现改变了现代物理学的范式。

entries.en: something wrapped and sent by post
entries.example: A parcel for you arrived this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上有一个给你的包裹到了。

entries.en: a small animal or insect that damages crops or food
entries.example: Farmers are fighting a new pest in the rice fields.
entries.exampleZh: 农民正在与稻田里的一种新害虫作斗争。

entries.en: a chemical used to kill insects that harm crops
entries.example: The label warns workers to handle the pesticide with care.
entries.exampleZh: 标签提醒工人小心处理这种杀虫剂。

entries.en: a large farm where one crop is grown
entries.example: Her grandfather worked on a tea plantation in the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 她的祖父在山里的一座茶园种植园工作。

entries.zh: 似乎可信的；貌似合理的
entries.en: seeming reasonable or likely to be true
entries.example: His excuse sounded plausible, but nobody believed it.
entries.exampleZh: 他的借口听起来似乎可信，但没人相信。

entries.en: dealing with problems in a practical way
entries.example: She took a pragmatic approach and fixed the old machine.
entries.exampleZh: 她采取了务实的做法，修好了那台旧机器。

entries.en: to make something happen suddenly or sooner
entries.example: A single poor decision can precipitate a serious crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 一个糟糕的决定就可能促成一场严重危机。

entries.en: rain, snow, or other water that falls from clouds
entries.example: Annual precipitation in this desert is under 100 millimetres.
entries.exampleZh: 这片沙漠的年降水量不足100毫米。

entries.en: relating to quality rather than numbers
entries.example: The interviews provided qualitative data about customers' feelings.
entries.exampleZh: 这些访谈提供了关于顾客感受的定性数据。

entries.en: the smallest unit of energy or matter in physics
entries.example: The lab built a quantum computer that works at very low temperatures.
entries.exampleZh: 该实验室造了一台在极低温度下工作的量子计算机。

entries.en: a device that uses radio waves to find objects
entries.example: The ship's radar showed a small boat ahead in the fog.
entries.exampleZh: 船上的雷达显示雾中前方有一条小船。

entries.en: to repeat a study or copy something exactly
entries.example: Other teams failed to replicate the original experiment.
entries.exampleZh: 其他团队未能重复最初的实验。

entries.en: the act of repeating a study to check its result
entries.example: The journal now asks for replication before publication.
entries.exampleZh: 该期刊现在要求在发表前进行重复实验。

entries.en: a large natural or artificial lake that stores water
entries.example: The city's reservoir supplies water to two million people.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的水库为两百万人供水。

entries.en: sacred writings of a religion
entries.example: The monks read from scripture every morning at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 僧侣们每天黎明诵读经文。

entries.en: sand or mud that settles at the bottom of water
entries.example: Thick layers of sediment covered the bottom of the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 厚厚的沉积物覆盖着湖底。

entries.en: relating to the meaning of words
entries.example: The two sentences differ in their semantic structure.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个句子在语义结构上不同。

entries.en: a vehicle that travels regularly between two places
entries.example: A free shuttle runs between the hotel and the airport.
entries.exampleZh: 酒店和机场之间有免费班车往返。

entries.en: being the form of a word for one person or thing
entries.example: In 'one child', the noun is singular.
entries.exampleZh: 在 one child 中，名词是单数形式。

entries.en: a thick flat piece of stone or other material
entries.example: Workers lifted a heavy slab of stone onto the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们把一块沉重的石板抬到墙上。

entries.en: to cut something greatly or reduce it sharply
entries.example: The company will slash prices during the holiday sale.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将在节日促销期间大幅降价。

entries.en: to draw air in through the nose to smell something
entries.example: The dog stopped to sniff the ground near the gate.
entries.exampleZh: 狗停下来闻了闻大门附近的地面。

entries.en: to spend time with other people or animals
entries.example: Puppies need to socialize with people before twelve weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 幼犬需要在十二周前与人交往。

entries.en: unwanted electrical charge that builds up on a surface
entries.example: The blanket crackled with static in the dry air.
entries.exampleZh: 干燥的空气里，毯子噼啪作响，带着静电。

entries.en: relating to medical operations
entries.example: The doctor said the injury might need surgical treatment.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说这个伤可能需要手术治疗。

entries.en: easily affected or harmed by something
entries.example: Young children are more susceptible to colds in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿在冬天更容易感冒。

entries.en: to give something and get something else in return
entries.example: Can we swap seats so that I can sit by the window?
entries.exampleZh: 我们能换一下座位吗，这样我可以靠窗坐？

entries.en: made by chemical processes rather than from natural materials
entries.example: This jacket is made of synthetic fibres that dry very quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 这件夹克由干得很快的合成纤维制成。

entries.en: relating to time
entries.example: The study found a temporal link between night noise and headaches.
entries.exampleZh: 这项研究发现了夜间噪音与头痛在时间上的关联。

entries.en: relating to heat or keeping heat in
entries.example: Thermal socks keep your feet warm on cold hikes.
entries.exampleZh: 在寒冷的徒步中，保温袜能让你的双脚保持温暖。

entries.en: the ability to bear something difficult without being harmed
entries.example: Her tolerance for cold improved after a winter in Norway.
entries.exampleZh: 在挪威过了一个冬天后，她对寒冷的耐受力提高了。

entries.en: a tube or system of tubes inside the body
entries.example: Smoking damages the respiratory tract and makes breathing harder.
entries.exampleZh: 吸烟会损伤呼吸道，使呼吸更加困难。

entries.en: not important or serious
entries.example: They argued for an hour about a trivial detail in the contract.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为一个合同里的琐碎细节争论了一个小时。

entries.en: moving in an uneven, violent way
entries.example: The pilot warned us that the air would be turbulent over the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员提醒我们，飞越山区时气流会很颠簸。

entries.en: a university student who has not yet received a degree
entries.example: As an undergraduate, she spent a summer studying frogs in the wetlands.
entries.exampleZh: 读本科时，她花了一个夏天在湿地研究青蛙。

entries.en: impossible to understand
entries.example: The announcement was so distorted that it sounded unintelligible.
entries.exampleZh: 广播通知失真得厉害，听起来难以理解。

entries.en: the liquid waste that leaves the body
entries.example: The nurse sent a urine sample to the laboratory.
entries.exampleZh: 护士把一份尿液样本送到了实验室。

entries.en: the way something is used, or the act of using it
entries.example: The dictionary gives examples of usage for each new word.
entries.exampleZh: 这本词典为每个新词给出用法示例。

entries.en: a part that controls the flow of liquid, gas or blood
entries.example: A plumber replaced the valve under the kitchen sink.
entries.exampleZh: 水管工更换了厨房水槽下面的阀门。

entries.en: plants in general, especially those growing in one area
entries.example: Thick vegetation covered the path within a month of rain.
entries.exampleZh: 一场雨后一个月内，茂密的植被就盖住了小路。

entries.en: the speed of something moving in a particular direction
entries.example: Engineers measured the velocity of the water before building the wheel.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在建造水轮之前测量了水流的速度。

entries.en: all the words that a person knows or that a language uses
entries.example: Reading novels widened his vocabulary more than any textbook.
entries.exampleZh: 读小说比任何教科书都更大地扩充了他的词汇量。

entries.en: a grain used to make flour and bread
entries.example: Farmers here plant wheat in autumn and harvest it in July.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的农民秋天种小麦，七月收割。

entries.en: by which; through which
entries.example: They agreed on a plan whereby each member would teach one skill.
entries.exampleZh: 他们商定了一个方案，凭此每个成员都要教一项技能。

entries.en: the distant past, especially ancient times
entries.example: The coins date from antiquity and were found in a field.
entries.exampleZh: 这些硬币属于古代，是在一片田里发现的。

entries.en: using only two states, such as 0 and 1
entries.example: Computers store every photograph as binary code.
entries.exampleZh: 计算机把每张照片都存成二进制代码。

entries.en: a board game for two players, played with kings, queens and pawns
entries.example: My grandfather taught me chess on a rainy afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 祖父在一个下雨的午后教我下国际象棋。

entries.en: a thread-like structure in cells that carries genes
entries.example: Each human cell contains 46 chromosomes, half of them from each parent.
entries.exampleZh: 每个人体细胞含有 46 条染色体，其中一半来自父亲，一半来自母亲。

entries.en: a line on a map joining points of the same height
entries.example: The hikers followed a contour on the map to avoid the steep climb.
entries.exampleZh: 徒步者沿着地图上的一条等高线走，以避开陡峭的爬升。

entries.en: relating to the arteries that supply blood to the heart
entries.example: Her doctor warned that smoking raises the risk of coronary disease.
entries.exampleZh: 她的医生警告说，吸烟会增加患冠状动脉疾病的风险。

entries.en: a large collection of texts or recordings used for study
entries.example: The researchers built a corpus of letters from the eighteenth century.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员建立了一个十八世纪书信的语料库。

entries.en: to make someone believe something that is not true
entries.example: The advertisement deceived buyers about the size of the box.
entries.exampleZh: 这则广告在包装盒尺寸上欺骗了买家。

entries.en: a movement away from a straight line or a fixed position
entries.example: The engineer measured the deflection of the bridge under heavy trucks.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师测量了重型卡车通过时桥梁的挠度。

entries.en: to be a sign of something
entries.example: A red light on the panel denotes a fault in the cooling system.
entries.exampleZh: 面板上的红灯表示冷却系统出现故障。

entries.en: a form of a language spoken in one region
entries.example: She grew up speaking a local dialect that her cousins could barely understand.
entries.exampleZh: 她从小讲一种表亲们几乎听不懂的当地方言。

entries.en: separate and clearly different
entries.example: The course is divided into eight discrete units, each with its own test.
entries.exampleZh: 这门课分成八个独立的单元，每个单元各有一次测验。

entries.en: to change information into a form a computer can store
entries.example: The app encodes each photo before sending it to the server.
entries.exampleZh: 这个应用会把每张照片编码后再发送到服务器。

entries.en: the study of how diseases spread among people
entries.example: Epidemiology helped officials trace the outbreak to a single water pump.
entries.exampleZh: 流行病学帮助官员把这次疫情追溯到一个水泵。

entries.en: one part of a situation or problem
entries.example: Cost is only one facet of the decision to move abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 费用只是决定移居国外的其中一个方面。

entries.en: a thin part on a fish that helps it swim
entries.example: The injured fish swam in circles, one fin trailing behind it.
entries.exampleZh: 那条受伤的鱼绕着圈游，一只鳍拖在后面。

entries.en: having a limit or an end
entries.example: Our budget is finite, so we cannot hire another designer this year.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的预算有限，所以今年不能再雇一名设计师。

entries.en: a state of continuous change
entries.example: The market is in flux, and prices change from one week to the next.
entries.exampleZh: 市场处于不断变化之中，价格每周都在变。

entries.en: disagreement between two people or groups
entries.example: There was some friction between the two teams over the shared lab.
entries.exampleZh: 两个团队因为共用实验室而有些摩擦。

entries.en: a disease that damages the liver
entries.example: The clinic tested every new patient for hepatitis after the flood.
entries.exampleZh: 洪水过后，诊所给每位新病人做了肝炎检查。

entries.en: the creation of a current by a changing magnetic field
entries.example: The charger uses electromagnetic induction to power the phone without a cable.
entries.exampleZh: 这个充电器利用电磁感应，不用线就能给手机供电。

entries.en: to turn something upside down
entries.example: Invert the jar gently so that the honey runs into the bowl.
entries.exampleZh: 把罐子轻轻倒过来，让蜂蜜流进碗里。

entries.en: supplying water to land for crops
entries.example: Drip irrigation uses far less water than flooding the fields.
entries.exampleZh: 滴灌比大水漫灌田地省水得多。

entries.en: a unit for measuring liquid
entries.example: She drinks about a liter of water during every training session.
entries.exampleZh: 她每次训练大约喝一升水。

entries.en: the place where something happens or is focused
entries.example: The locus of the infection was the lower left lung.
entries.exampleZh: 感染的位置在左肺下部。

entries.en: an experienced person who advises someone over time
entries.example: My mentor read every draft and told me honestly what needed work.
entries.exampleZh: 我的导师读了每一稿，坦率地告诉我哪里需要改进。

entries.en: a heavy silver metal that is liquid at room temperature
entries.example: Old thermometers contain mercury, so they must be recycled carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 旧温度计含有汞，所以必须小心回收。

entries.en: the chemical processes that keep a body alive
entries.example: Regular exercise can speed up your metabolism and help you sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能加快新陈代谢，还有助于睡眠。

entries.en: a unit for measuring the amount of a substance
entries.example: The chemist recorded the sample in moles instead of grams.
entries.exampleZh: 这位化学家用摩尔而不是克来记录这份样本。

entries.en: a cell that carries signals in the nervous system
entries.example: Each neuron connects to thousands of others in the brain.
entries.exampleZh: 大脑中每个神经元都与数千个其他神经元相连。

entries.en: a system of written symbols
entries.example: She learned musical notation before she could play a single tune.
entries.exampleZh: 她还没学会弹一首曲子就先学了乐谱记法。

entries.en: a person who is new to an activity
entries.example: As a novice, he asked more questions than anyone else in the class.
entries.exampleZh: 作为新手，他提的问题比班上任何人都多。

entries.en: forward in time or space
entries.example: From the second week onwards, the shop opens at eight.
entries.exampleZh: 从第二周起，这家店八点开门。

entries.en: movement back and forth
entries.example: The oscillation of the bridge worried engineers during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨中桥的摆动让工程师们很担心。

entries.en: a thin wall that divides a room
entries.example: A glass partition separates the office from the meeting room.
entries.exampleZh: 一道玻璃隔断把办公室和会议室分开。

entries.en: relating to the normal functions of the body
entries.example: Deep breathing produces a measurable physiological response within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 深呼吸几分钟内就会产生可测量的生理反应。

entries.en: a short test with questions
entries.example: The teacher gave a short quiz on Friday to check our progress.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在星期五安排了一个小测验来检查我们的进度。

entries.en: the distance from the centre of a circle to its edge
entries.example: Every point within a radius of five kilometres was searched.
entries.exampleZh: 方圆五公里内的每个地点都被搜寻过了。

entries.en: a tiny structure that detects a signal such as light or smell
entries.example: A receptor in the nose reacts to even a faint smell.
entries.exampleZh: 鼻子里的受体即使对微弱的气味也会有反应。

entries.en: the full range of skills or pieces someone can use
entries.example: The pianist's repertoire includes works by Bach and Chopin.
entries.exampleZh: 这位钢琴家的常备曲目包括巴赫和肖邦的作品。

entries.en: relating to breathing or the organs used for it
entries.example: Smoking damages the respiratory system over many years.
entries.exampleZh: 吸烟会在多年间损害呼吸系统。

entries.en: to move text or images up or down on a screen
entries.example: She scrolled through the photos until she found his face.
entries.exampleZh: 她滚动浏览照片，直到找到他的脸。

entries.en: to produce and release a liquid from a cell or gland
entries.example: The glands in our skin secrete a thin layer of oil.
entries.exampleZh: 我们皮肤里的腺体会分泌一层薄薄的油脂。

entries.en: relating to the senses such as touch, sight or hearing
entries.example: The skin is packed with sensory nerve endings.
entries.exampleZh: 皮肤上布满了感觉神经末梢。

entries.en: a liquid that can dissolve another substance
entries.example: The chemist added a solvent to dissolve the yellow powder.
entries.exampleZh: 化学家加入一种溶剂来溶解黄色粉末。

entries.en: the male cell that can join an egg to start new life
entries.example: The male fish releases sperm into the water.
entries.exampleZh: 雄鱼把精子释放到水中。

entries.en: a single unit of sound in a spoken word
entries.example: The name has three syllables and is easy to say.
entries.exampleZh: 这个名字有三个音节，很容易念。

entries.en: the special words used in a particular subject
entries.example: The doctor explained the terminology in simple language.
entries.exampleZh: 医生用简单的语言解释了这些术语。

entries.en: to write down something that was spoken or recorded
entries.example: She transcribed the whole interview word for word.
entries.exampleZh: 她把整段采访逐字转写了下来。

entries.en: something that carries and passes on a gene or disease
entries.example: The mosquito is a vector for several dangerous diseases.
entries.exampleZh: 蚊子是几种危险疾病的传播媒介。

entries.en: a tiny fungus used to make bread rise or beer ferment
entries.example: Warm water helps the yeast make the dough rise.
entries.exampleZh: 温水能帮助酵母让面团发起来。

entries.en: relating to a chemical group found in proteins
entries.example: Amino acids are the building blocks of every protein.
entries.exampleZh: 氨基酸是构成每一种蛋白质的基本单元。

entries.en: an object made by people, often of historical interest
entries.example: The museum displayed artifacts from a nearby village.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了附近一个村落的文物。

entries.en: able to speak two languages, or written in two
entries.example: The school offers a bilingual programme in English and Chinese.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校提供英汉双语课程。

entries.en: medical treatment that uses drugs to kill cancer cells
entries.example: She lost her hair during six months of chemotherapy.
entries.exampleZh: 她在六个月的化疗期间掉光了头发。

entries.en: to confuse someone or make a result unclear
entries.example: Poor sleep may confound the results of the memory test.
entries.exampleZh: 睡眠不足可能会干扰记忆测试的结果。

entries.en: the cutting open of a dead body or plant to study it
entries.example: The biology class watched a dissection of a frog.
entries.exampleZh: 生物课观看了青蛙解剖。

entries.en: a long piece of writing done for a university degree
entries.example: He spent two years writing his dissertation on ancient tools.
entries.exampleZh: 他花了两年时间写关于古代工具的学位论文。

entries.en: a person who takes part in a competition
entries.example: Each entrant had ten minutes to present a project.
entries.exampleZh: 每位参赛者有十分钟展示一个项目。

entries.en: relating to a baby that is still growing in the womb
entries.example: Fetal hearing develops long before the baby is born.
entries.exampleZh: 胎儿的听觉在出生前很久就发育了。

entries.en: the degree to which a surface or amount changes
entries.example: The road has a steep gradient near the top.
entries.exampleZh: 这条路靠近坡顶的地方坡度很陡。

entries.en: correct according to the rules of a language
entries.example: Her sentence was clear but not fully grammatical.
entries.exampleZh: 她的句子意思清楚，但不完全合乎语法。

entries.en: a space or amount that has no limit
entries.example: The child's questions seemed to stretch to infinity.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子的问题似乎无穷无尽。

entries.en: present from birth rather than learned
entries.example: Babies seem to have an innate sense of rhythm.
entries.exampleZh: 婴儿似乎天生就有节奏感。

entries.en: following the same people over a long period
entries.example: The longitudinal study followed 500 children for ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 这项纵向研究跟踪了500名儿童十年。

entries.en: the soft tissue inside bones that produces blood cells
entries.example: A bone marrow transplant can save patients with certain blood diseases.
entries.exampleZh: 骨髓移植可以挽救某些血液病患者。

entries.en: a unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter
entries.example: The crack in the pipe was less than a millimeter wide.
entries.exampleZh: 管道上的裂缝不到一毫米宽。

entries.en: relating to the form and structure of words
entries.example: The paper traced morphological changes in English verb endings over five centuries.
entries.exampleZh: 这篇论文追溯了五个世纪以来英语动词词尾的形态变化。

entries.en: the study of how words are formed and built
entries.example: Students of morphology learn how prefixes and suffixes change a word's meaning.
entries.exampleZh: 学习形态学的学生要了解前缀和后缀如何改变词义。

entries.en: relating to the nerves or the nervous system
entries.example: The scan showed unusual neural activity in the patient's left hemisphere.
entries.exampleZh: 扫描显示患者左半球有异常的神经活动。

entries.en: having no value or effect; not valid
entries.example: The researchers declared the trial null after the equipment failed.
entries.exampleZh: 设备出现故障后，研究人员宣布该试验无效。

entries.en: the best possible level or condition
entries.example: The team found the optimum by testing each temperature in turn.
entries.exampleZh: 团队逐一测试各个温度，找出了最佳点。

entries.en: extremely impressive or remarkable
entries.example: Her phenomenal memory let her recite the whole poem after one reading.
entries.exampleZh: 她惊人的记忆力让她读一遍就能背下整首诗。

entries.en: a chemical compound containing phosphorus and oxygen
entries.example: Too much phosphate from farm runoff can cause algae to bloom in lakes.
entries.exampleZh: 农场径流带来的过多磷酸盐会导致湖泊藻类暴发。

entries.en: a soft silvery metal that is a mineral in food
entries.example: Bananas are a well-known source of potassium, a mineral that helps muscles work.
entries.exampleZh: 香蕉是众所周知的钾来源，钾是一种有助于肌肉运作的矿物质。

entries.en: a short book that explains the basics of a subject
entries.example: This slim primer explains the basics of chemistry in plain language.
entries.exampleZh: 这本薄薄的入门书用通俗的语言讲解了化学基础知识。

entries.en: a positive particle in the nucleus of an atom
entries.example: A hydrogen atom has one proton and one electron.
entries.exampleZh: 氢原子有一个质子和一个电子。

entries.en: able to dissolve in a liquid
entries.example: Salt and sugar are highly soluble and disappear in warm water.
entries.exampleZh: 盐和糖极易溶解，在温水中会消失不见。

entries.en: the substance that an enzyme acts on
entries.example: The enzyme binds to its substrate before the reaction begins.
entries.exampleZh: 酶在反应开始前与其底物结合。

entries.en: to take one number away from another
entries.example: If you subtract five from twelve, you get seven.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你从十二中减去五，就得到七。

entries.en: a list of the topics and readings in a course
entries.example: The syllabus lists every reading, test and deadline for the term.
entries.exampleZh: 教学大纲列出了本学期所有的阅读材料、考试和截止日期。

entries.en: the curved path of a moving object
entries.example: Engineers tracked the rocket's trajectory to predict where it would land.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师跟踪火箭的轨迹，以预测它的落点。

entries.en: the quality of being open and easy to see through
entries.example: Voters demanded greater transparency in how public money was spent.
entries.exampleZh: 选民要求在公共资金的支出方式上提高透明度。

entries.en: a speech sound made with an open mouth
entries.example: The letter a is a vowel, while the letter b is not.
entries.exampleZh: 字母 a 是元音，而字母 b 不是。

entries.en: a turning point that changes the course of events
entries.example: The invention of printing was a watershed in the history of reading.
entries.exampleZh: 印刷术的发明是阅读史上的一个转折点。

entries.en: a branch of maths that uses letters for unknown numbers
entries.example: In algebra, students use letters to stand for unknown numbers.
entries.exampleZh: 在代数中，学生用字母代表未知数。

entries.en: the height of a wave measured from its middle
entries.example: A louder sound produces a wave with a greater amplitude.
entries.exampleZh: 更响的声音会产生振幅更大的波。

entries.en: the variety of plants and animals in an area
entries.example: The rainforest's biodiversity attracts scientists from around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 雨林的生物多样性吸引着世界各地的科学家。

entries.en: a compound of chlorine with another element
entries.example: Table salt is sodium chloride, a compound of two elements.
entries.exampleZh: 食盐是氯化钠，是一种由两种元素组成的化合物。

entries.en: about or approximately, used with dates
entries.example: The temple was built circa 500 BC, according to the guide.
entries.exampleZh: 据导游介绍，这座神庙大约建于公元前500年。

entries.en: a speech sound made by blocking the airflow
entries.example: The word strength begins with three consonant sounds in a row.
entries.exampleZh: 单词 strength 以三个连续的辅音开头。

entries.en: the outer layer of an organ such as the brain
entries.example: The outer layer of the brain, the cortex, handles complex thought.
entries.exampleZh: 大脑的外层，即皮层，负责处理复杂的思维。

entries.en: the act of putting something in the opposite order
entries.example: English questions often use inversion, placing the verb before the subject.
entries.exampleZh: 英语疑问句常用倒装，把动词放在主语之前。

entries.en: relating to the words of a language
entries.example: The teacher focused on lexical choice rather than grammar.
entries.exampleZh: 老师关注的是词汇选择，而不是语法。

entries.en: more than one; many
entries.example: They moved into a multi-storey building near the park.
entries.exampleZh: 他们搬进了公园附近的一栋多层建筑。

entries.en: relating to the sounds of a language
entries.example: Young children often make phonological errors when they speak.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿说话时常常出现语音错误。

entries.en: a student who continues studying after a first degree
entries.example: My cousin is a postgraduate in the chemistry department.
entries.exampleZh: 我表姐是化学系的研究生。

entries.en: to blow air out of your nose suddenly
entries.example: Dust in the old room made me sneeze twice.
entries.exampleZh: 旧房间里的灰尘让我打了两个喷嚏。

entries.en: relating to the structure of sentences
entries.example: The error was syntactic, so the meaning was still clear.
entries.exampleZh: 这个错误属于句法层面，所以意思仍然清楚。

entries.en: the rules for arranging words into sentences
entries.example: English syntax usually places the subject before the verb.
entries.exampleZh: 英语句法通常把主语放在动词之前。

entries.en: a statement that can be proved by reasoning
entries.example: The class used the theorem to find the missing side.
entries.exampleZh: 全班用这个定理求出了缺失的那条边。

entries.en: tiny liquid or solid particles suspended in air
entries.example: The spray formed a fine aerosol that hung in the air.
entries.exampleZh: 喷雾形成了细密的气溶胶，悬浮在空中。

entries.en: a statement accepted as true without proof
entries.example: The proof begins with a simple axiom about parallel lines.
entries.exampleZh: 这个证明从一条关于平行线的简单公理开始。

entries.en: the mathematics of continuous change
entries.example: She used calculus to model the growth of the population.
entries.exampleZh: 她用微积分来模拟人口增长。

entries.en: relating to very narrow tubes
entries.example: Water climbed the narrow tube through capillary action.
entries.exampleZh: 水通过毛细作用沿着细管上升。

entries.en: a punctuation mark that separates parts of a sentence
entries.example: A comma before the name made the sentence easier to read.
entries.exampleZh: 名字前的逗号让这个句子更容易读。

entries.en: exactly equal in shape and size
entries.example: The two triangles are congruent, so their angles match.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个三角形全等，所以它们的角也相同。

entries.en: the number below the line in a fraction
entries.example: In the fraction three quarters, four is the denominator.
entries.exampleZh: 在四分之三这个分数里，四就是分母。

entries.en: a state of being equal in value or meaning
entries.example: The teacher explained the equivalence between the two units.
entries.exampleZh: 老师解释了这两种单位之间的等价关系。

entries.en: growing faster and faster as time passes
entries.example: The bacteria showed exponential growth in the warm dish.
entries.exampleZh: 细菌在温热的培养皿里呈指数增长。

entries.en: a curve that winds around a central line
entries.example: The vine grew in a tight helix around the pole.
entries.exampleZh: 藤蔓绕着杆子长成紧密的螺旋。

entries.en: a chemical used to kill unwanted plants
entries.example: The farmer sprayed herbicide along the edge of the field.
entries.exampleZh: 农民沿着田边喷洒了除草剂。

entries.en: half or partly
entries.example: Our team reached the semi-final of the school cup.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队打进了校杯半决赛。

entries.en: to join two pieces together end to end
entries.example: He used tape to splice the two wires together.
entries.exampleZh: 他用胶带把两根电线接在一起。

entries.en: an idea or feeling a word suggests
entries.example: The word 'cheap' has a negative connotation for many buyers.
entries.exampleZh: 对许多买家来说，cheap 这个词带有负面含义。

entries.en: a word or phrase used to describe something
entries.example: The report used 'coastal' as a descriptor for the region.
entries.exampleZh: 报告用 coastal 作为描述该地区的词。

entries.en: to combine with oxygen and change chemically
entries.example: Cut apples oxidize and turn brown within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 切开的苹果会氧化，几分钟内就变成褐色。

entries.en: a phrase added inside a sentence for extra information
entries.example: The extra detail sat in parenthesis at the end of the sentence.
entries.exampleZh: 这个额外细节放在句子末尾的插入语里。

entries.en: one of two teaching periods in a school year
entries.example: She will study abroad during her final semester.
entries.exampleZh: 她将在最后一个学期出国学习。

entries.en: across or beyond
entries.example: The airline offers a daily trans-Atlantic flight.
entries.exampleZh: 这家航空公司每天提供一班横跨大西洋的航班。

entries.en: the power to choose and decide for yourself
entries.example: He left the job by his own volition.
entries.exampleZh: 他自愿辞去了那份工作。

entries.en: the product of a whole number and all smaller whole numbers
entries.example: The factorial of five is one hundred and twenty.
entries.exampleZh: 五的阶乘是一百二十。

entries.en: a substance that is dissolved in a liquid
entries.example: Stir the solute into warm water until it disappears.
entries.exampleZh: 把溶质搅进温水，直到它消失。

entries.en: in the middle of a period or range
entries.example: The shop is always quiet in the mid-afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店在下午过半时总是很安静。

entries.en: a flying vehicle with wings and engines
entries.example: The airplane climbed slowly above the thick grey clouds.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机缓缓爬升到厚厚的灰云之上。

entries.en: a painting, drawing or other creative piece
entries.example: The gallery hung her artwork beside the main entrance.
entries.exampleZh: 画廊把她的作品挂在正门旁边。

entries.en: a sudden failure of a machine or system
entries.example: A sudden breakdown in the heating closed the school.
entries.exampleZh: 供暖系统突然故障，学校因此停课。

entries.en: a room where lessons are taught
entries.example: The classroom smelled of chalk and fresh paint.
entries.exampleZh: 教室里有一股粉笔和新油漆的气味。

entries.en: comments about how well something was done
entries.example: Her written feedback helped me rewrite the whole introduction.
entries.exampleZh: 她写下的反馈帮我重写了整个引言。

entries.en: a note at the bottom of a page
entries.example: The footnote explains where the statistic came from.
entries.exampleZh: 这条脚注说明了那个统计数据的来源。

entries.en: at the middle point of a distance or period
entries.example: We stopped for coffee halfway through the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在长途旅行的中途停下来喝咖啡。

entries.en: printed material given to students or listeners
entries.example: Please read the handout before the next lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 请在下一节课之前读一读这份讲义。

entries.en: schoolwork that students do at home
entries.example: She finished her homework before dinner last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨晚在晚饭前完成了家庭作业。

entries.en: the way text and pictures are arranged on a page
entries.example: The new layout makes the menu much easier to read.
entries.exampleZh: 新的版面让菜单容易读多了。

entries.en: the way a person lives from day to day
entries.example: His healthy lifestyle includes long walks and early nights.
entries.exampleZh: 他健康的生活方式包括长途散步和早睡。

entries.en: the whole period during which someone is alive
entries.example: He travelled little during his lifetime but read widely.
entries.exampleZh: 他一生很少出门旅行，但读书广博。

entries.en: a route or way from one place to another
entries.example: A narrow pathway leads from the gate to the river.
entries.exampleZh: 一条窄窄的小路从大门通到河边。

entries.en: the amount of rain that falls in a place
entries.example: The rainfall here doubles in the summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的降雨量在夏季几个月里翻倍。

entries.en: a book used for studying a subject
entries.example: We worked through chapter five of the textbook.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学完了教科书的第五章。

entries.en: a rise in mood or level
entries.example: The festival brought a real uplift to the town.
entries.exampleZh: 这个节日给小镇带来了真正的振奋。

entries.en: the distance between two waves of light or sound
entries.example: Blue light has a shorter wavelength than red light.
entries.exampleZh: 蓝光的波长比红光短。

entries.en: found in many places or among many people
entries.example: There is widespread support for the new library.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆得到了广泛的支持。

entries.en: a practical class or a room for making things
entries.example: The workshop taught us how to repair old lamps.
entries.exampleZh: 这个工作坊教我们修理旧台灯。

entries.en: against or opposed to something
entries.example: They organised an anti-waste campaign at school.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在学校组织了一场反浪费活动。

entries.en: former; no longer in that role
entries.example: Her ex-husband still repairs bicycles with her.
entries.exampleZh: 她的前夫仍然和她一起修自行车。

entries.en: very small in size or scale
entries.example: The charity offers micro-credit to village shops.
entries.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构向乡村小店提供小额信贷。

entries.en: new, or a modern version of something old
entries.example: The neo-classical hall was built in 1902.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新古典主义礼堂建于1902年。

entries.en: not; the opposite of
entries.example: She bought a non-stick pan for the new kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 她为新厨房买了一口不粘锅。

entries.en: the number equal to a circle's circumference divided by its diameter
entries.example: We used pi to work out the area of the circle.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用圆周率算出了这个圆的面积。

entries.en: the most northern or southern point of the earth
entries.example: The explorers planted a flag at the pole after a long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 探险者们在长途跋涉之后把一面旗帜插在了极点。

entries.en: before in time, or in advance
entries.example: The museum displays pre-war photographs of the old harbour.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了那座老港口战前的照片。

entries.en: under, below, or less than
entries.example: The pipes froze in sub-zero temperatures last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到零度以下，水管都冻住了。

entries.en: extremely, or above others
entries.example: A super-rich businessman bought the whole island last year.
entries.exampleZh: 一位超级富有的商人去年买下了整座岛。

entries.en: to establish the main office of a company in a place
entries.example: The firm decided to headquarter its European office in Berlin.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司决定把欧洲总部设在柏林。

entries.en: exactly the same in every detail
entries.example: The two sisters wore identical dresses to the party.
entries.exampleZh: 两姐妹穿着完全相同的连衣裙去参加聚会。

entries.en: a person related to someone who lived long ago
entries.example: She is a direct descendant of the town's first mayor.
entries.exampleZh: 她是该镇第一任市长的直系后代。

cloze.title: A Fair for the Library
cloze.text: Last spring our street held a small fair for the town library. Mr. Hale, a retired mail {{q1}} who had spent thirty years delivering letters in all weather, offered to lead the planning. His {{q2}} skills surprised everyone: he painted a bright banner and arranged the stalls so that they looked like a single picture. The fair was a {{q3}} effort, with dozens of families baking bread and lending tables. A shy girl of nine, {{q4}} the volunteers, turned out to be the best salesperson. On the morning of the event, Mr. Hale ignored the {{q5}} strain of carrying boxes and kept working until noon. We counted the money on the library steps {{q6}}, once the last visitor had gone. He walked home keeping his eyes on the road ahead, without a {{q7}} glance at the empty square, already talking about next year.
cloze.translationZh: 去年春天，我们这条街为镇上的图书馆举办了一场小型集市。黑尔先生是一位退休的邮递员，三十年来风雨无阻地送信，这次他主动提出负责策划。他的艺术才能让大家惊讶：他画了一面鲜亮的横幅，还把摊位布置得像一幅完整的画。这场集市是大家共同努力的成果，几十个家庭烤了面包，还借出了桌子。在志愿者当中，一个害羞的九岁女孩竟然成了最出色的售货员。活动当天早上，黑尔先生不顾搬箱子给身体带来的劳累，一直干到中午。最后一位客人离开后，我们在图书馆的台阶上清点了收入。他眼睛看着前面的路走回家，没有回头看一眼空荡荡的广场，已经在谈论明年的集市了。

questions.explanationZh: 前文说他“花了三十年风雨无阻地送信”，说明他的工作是投递邮件，mail carrier 正是“邮递员”的固定说法。carrier 在这里指“运送者、投递员”。sorter 是“分拣员”，inspector 是“检查员”，他们都不负责把信送到住户门口，与 delivering letters 的线索不合。
冒号后写他画横幅、把摊位布置得像一幅画，这些靠的是审美能力。artistic 意为“艺术的、有艺术才能的”。athletic 是“运动方面的”，technical 是“技术上的”，画横幅和布置摊位并不依赖体能或技术规范。
后面说几十个家庭烤面包、借桌子，说明这场集市是大家一起完成的。collective 意为“集体的、共同的”。personal 是“个人的”，solo 是“独自的”，都与 dozens of families 的线索矛盾。
后文说这个九岁女孩成了最出色的售货员，说明她本身就是志愿者中的一员。amongst 意为“在……之中”。beside 表示“在……旁边”的位置关系，beyond 表示“超出……之外”，都不能表达“是其中一员”。
当时他在搬箱子，并且一直干到中午，劳累来自体力劳动。bodily 意为“身体的”。mental 是“精神上的”，social 是“社交的”，搬箱子造成的 strain 显然不是精神或社交层面的。
时间线索很明确：等最后一位客人离开之后才清点收入。afterward 意为“之后、后来”。meanwhile 表示“与此同时”，instead 表示“代替、反而”，都与这个先后顺序不符。
他“眼睛看着前面的路”，又已经在谈明年的集市，说明他没有回头看。backward 意为“向后的”，a backward glance 就是“回头一看”。forward 是“向前的”，与“看着前面的路”重复且矛盾；upward 是“向上的”，与广场无关。

cloze.title: Writing Our Serial Story
cloze.text: Our class is writing a serial story for the school magazine, one chapter each week. Our teacher insists on {{q1}} between chapters: a character cannot suddenly change her name or forget a promise. She also warns us not to {{q2}} from one scene to an entire century of history; a single street festival does not tell us how a whole town lived. When we describe a character, she asks for a {{q3}} answer — kind or cruel — not a vague guess. Still, we may {{q4}} invent dialogues, as long as the setting is accurate. Every Monday we compare drafts, and someone always offers a sharp {{q5}} that sums up a whole decade in one sentence. What matters most, our teacher says, is the {{q6}} of ordinary people who risked their lives to hide strangers, and the patient {{q7}} that turns their scattered notes into a timeline.
